label: Document Parser
description: Parses documents (from a URL or uploaded files) into text, with language and parsing-instruction controls for tables, columns, and target pages.

config.name: inputType
config.description: Parse a document by URL or by uploaded file.

config.name: documentLink
config.description: Document URL when inputType is link.

config.name: uploadedFiles
config.description: Uploaded file objects when inputType is upload.

produces.note: Ingests a DOCUMENT (URL or uploaded file) and produces its extracted text as one blob. It does NOT split text into named fields; for that, use an AI Extract Information node downstream.
